# The Standard for Canadian Media & Technology Insights

The Media Technology Monitor is Canada's national dataset on media, technology, and content consumption — used by broadcasters, advertisers, and government to support funding, policy, and strategic decisions with evidence, not assumptions.

[Request a Demo](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/fr/request-demo/) Explore More

<!-- LEFT: Heading + Topic Tabs -->

## Access Trusted Research On

Technology Trends Track rapid shifts across streaming platforms, AI advancements, connected devices, and emerging technologies. Identify where consumer demand is heading next.

Media Behaviour Understand attention, viewing habits, engagement, and platform usage across audiences and channels. See exactly where and how Canadians are spending their time.

5,000+ Variables Every insight above is backed by variables across demographics, attitudes, and intent, across Canada's most comprehensive media and technology dataset.

## The MTM Suite

The MTM Suite brings together four powerful data products, in-depth library reports, and interactive analytics tools—all in one integrated platform

Reports Library

### 70 + Reports Published Annually

Access a growing library of reports, infographics, and trend analyses covering media, technology, platforms, behaviours, and demographic groups across Canada — available in both official languages. Explore the latest findings or download a sample report to see the depth of MTM insights.

## Frequently Asked Questions

When is data released for MTM 18+, MTM Jr., MTM Newcomers, and the MTM Census Tool?

Release schedules vary by product: MTM 18+: Releases twice a year, with Fall data available in February and Spring data available in July. MTM Junior: Releases annually in May. MTM Newcomers: Releases annually in October or November. MTM Census Tool: Updated with new Statistics Canada Census data following each national census. The next update, based on the 2026 Census, is expected in Spring/Summer 2027.

How much does it cost for an MTM subscription?

Costs will vary based on the size of your organization as well as which MTM products you opt in for. We offer discounts for those who subscribe to multiple MTM products. Contact us today for a quote and more details.

How many accounts/seats does an MTM subscription come with?

We offer an unlimited amount of seats for subscribers and include a self-sign up page for users.

Can I buy an individual report?

A subscription to an MTM product includes full access to its suite of reports and web-based tools. Reports are not available for individual purchase.

Got a question not listed here? Speak to our chatbot
